name: M & M Moving & Delivery
hours: Thursday (Thanksgiving), Open 24 hours, Hours might differ

reviewSamples.author: Photo of dusty webb
reviewSamples.text: Absolutely amazing experience! Called Mike on a Sunday morning. Within 1 hour he had Earl dispatched on location to move a pool table across town. Not only did he delicately dismantle it, but expertly reassembled it as well. Incredibly friendly staff. Prompt, professional, and such a pleasure to do business with. I strongly recommend M & M for your moving needs. Will gladly be doing business here again. I cant thank you enough guys! Well done!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Linda
reviewSamples.text: One of the best companies I've worked with in all Fort Myers. On time, respectful, courteous, professional, hard working, caring, no wasting time ... M&M Moving values its reputation and the experience reflects that. They were recommended to me and I am recommending them to you. Great group of men.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Daniel Ayuso
reviewSamples.text: Thank you Michael and staff. Highly professional in every manner. They have moved home furnishings for me on 3 separate occasions in the last 12 months. Each move was carried out with precision. Movers arrived at the desired time on each occasion. Great care was taken with each piece of furniture. Blankets and plastic were used where ever  they were needed.  5 STARS  on a job well done. WOULD HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Tiffany Davis
reviewSamples.text: I hired this moving company last month on a short notice. These guys were able to accommodate me with all of my needs regardless of how short of a notice I provided. I moved from a 4 bedroom home and the movers were able to fit everything into my new 3 bedroom apartmnet with no issues.The elevator was broken, the movers were able to complete the entire move (with big bulky furniture), within the time frame given while using the stairs, with no extra charge. I would recommend these movers to everyone trying to move with a budget and timeframe. They will get you settled in with no issues. Mike and Donnail went the extra mile. I will use M&M Moving for all of my moving needs.
